title: Page 9
content_zh:
他们扯着不知道能不能实现的未来，计划起明天、明年，说着说着，商天雨忍不住掉泪，因为心感安慰，也因为如果这是最后旅程，她很开心身边有人陪。
「我要带一大把红玫瑰给姊姊。」她说。
蒋誉记得，晴天最爱他送的红玫瑰，他说过，要为她盖一间种满玫瑰花的城堡，可惜来不及实现承诺。「好，很大很大一把。」
「我要告诉姊姊，阿誉是超好的男人。」
「多谢夸奖，我要告诉她，我会好好照顾她的跳跳，比她照顾得更好。」
她像在忏悔一样低下头说：「姊姊总是对我很好，可是我对她很糟。」
「你哪里对她很糟？」
「小时候，我要什么她都让我，连跟男朋友约会，都要把我带在身边。」
说起这个，他就不得不附和她了。「对，我交女朋友没那么窝囊过，一面谈情说爱一面当保母，那个时候，我真恨你，恨得牙痒痒的。」
她点头，然后很难过的闷声说：「现在我还要抢姊姊的男朋友，说不定轮到姊姊恨我恨得牙痒痒。」
「抢？你会不会太看得起自己？」
他推推她的笨脑袋，这家伙，满脑子装的全是罪恶感。
「什么意思？」
「你以为我是谁，想抢就可以抢走的男人？错，若我看不上眼，你再有钱、再漂亮都没用！重点是，我不是你的男朋友，我是你的责任。」他的额头碰上她的。
「责任？」
「你要负担我的下半辈子，我比你老，会比你更早得到老人痴呆症，到时候，你要推轮椅带我到处逛，还要帮我在手上戴银链，写上姓名住址和电话，如果我丢掉，就要赶快把我找回来。」
她皱眉。「听起来很可怕。」
「人家说脾气不好的人容易高血压，我脸臭、脾气烂，如果中风的话，你要每天带我去做复健，帮我擦澡换尿片。」
她打他。「你不要吓我。」
他随便她打，反正打是情，打越多情越浓，这样她才会舍不得撇下他。「我工作那么累，说不定早就有肝病，肝病很麻烦，你有没有看过《食物密码》？到时候，你要照书上写的，一餐一餐做给我吃。」

「停停停！不要再继续这个话题。」她捣起耳朵不想听。
「怕了？」
「怕。」她点头。
「那你还肯不肯爱我，介不介意和我在一起？」
「我要和阿誉在一起。」这种事，哪需要考虑！就算他得老年痴呆症、高血压、糖尿病、花柳病、爱滋病，她都要和他在一起。
他这才满意。「所以你没有抢走谁，你是在帮晴天负责任，她做不到的，你要帮忙她。」
「是这样吗？」她怀疑。
「是这样。」他笃定。
「那以后，姊姊当大老婆、我做小老婆。」她习惯孔融让梨，手足相亲。
「你自己拿红玫瑰到坟前跟晴天讨论吧，谁大谁小我没意见，你们姊妹自己去乔，不过……听说男人都比较宠爱小老婆，你认为晴天真的喜欢当老大？」
他用了另类方案解决她的罪恶感。
商天雨也觉得自己很蠢。明天进开刀房还能不能走出来都是未知数，居然讨论起顺序排行？
「商伯父明天回台湾，如果来得及，他会送你进手术室。」他最后还是决定通知商伯父，手术风险太高，不管是商伯父或跳跳，他都不希望两人遗憾。
「我爸？你为什么告诉他？」
「不要气他，天底下的孩子都不知道当父母有多辛苦。」
她噘嘴。「听起来，你很喜欢他？」
「我是喜欢他。」蒋誉坦承。商伯父不是坏人，只是个不知道如何应付失去亲人的男人。
「你们要不要去约个会？如果我老爸不排斥双性恋，我不介意你当我后母。」
她对他挤鼻子。
他亲她一记，继续玩下去。「放心，我不会虐待继女。」

商天雨噗哧笑开。「其实，我没气他。」
「我知道。」如果气，她怎会介意那些无聊诅咒，延误病情。
「他……还好吗？」
「不差，但他很想你。」
「阿誉……如果他赶不及，可不可以帮我传话，告诉他，我不气他。」
「他赶不及，等你动完刀，亲自告诉他。」这些话，他说得很心虚，检验报告榨乾了他的自信，这几天，他反覆挣扎，考虑着要不要放弃手术，他很害怕，怕自己是刽子手，毁了她最后几个月生命。
她不是个爱奢望的人，所以马上转移话题。「如果我醒来，忘记你是谁，怎么办？」
「再当一次作家先生，让你再一次爱上我。」
「如果到最后我决定去当仙女，你怎么办？」
蒋誉突地把她搂得紧紧紧，然后故作轻松的说：「我和晴天密谋过了，商妈妈归她、跳跳归我，所以仙女名单里，对不起，没有商天雨。」
「我会努力赢过这场手术，但是万一——」
「没有万一。」他切断她的话。
她拍拍他的大手，「让我说吧，我希望能把每件事都安排好。」
就像她安排他和杜绢的幸福？傻气，世上没有人或事可以被安排，若不是走到最后一步，没有人能知道自己被定在哪里。
他这么想，却没这样说，说的是——「你想安排什么？」
「不要为我哭，我要你开开心心送我到妈妈和姊姊身边。」
他想也不想的摇头，他不可能不哭、不可能开心，她在强人所难。搂紧她，把头埋进她颈窝问。
「我是外貌协会会员，如果手术后我不幸变成植物人，可不可以……在第一次感染的时候就放弃急救？」她扯着他的袖子，问得痛心。
他不回答。
「下葬的时候，阿誉可不可以帮我换上青鸟的舞衣？不管在不在你身边，我都会努力当阿誉的小青鸟，为阿誉带来幸福。」

他继续保持沉默。
她自顾自往下说：「等我变成货真价实的青鸟，我会在人间寻觅，为阿誉找个好女生，让她爱你、疼你，在未来几十年里，照顾你。」
「我不需要谁照顾。」
「要的，阿誉对工作太拚命，需要一个女人来照顾身体；阿誉的心灵很空寂，需要人倾听他的心声。打勾勾，如果我找到这样的好女人，我会让她穿着蓝色小洋装出现在阿誉面前，如果阿誉心动了，就努力追求她，好不好？」
她伸出大拇指、小指，要和他做约定，但蒋誉固执不肯，大掌一包，把她的小手包在掌中间。
「阿誉，我很担心你……」
「你该担心的是如何打赢明天的战争。」
「我当然会尽全力赢，不过是想让自己更放心，没有后顾之忧地往前行。」
她拉开包裹自己的大手，稚气地推出拇指小指。
蒋誉定定看着她，酸气袭上鼻心。手术成功率那么低，她的赌运偏又奇烂无比，交代后事难道真的成了她可以做的最后一件事？
他不想放手，不想让死神站在面前嘲弄他的爱情。两颗泪水滑下，他不准自己哽咽，别开脸，仍拥她在怀问。
「阿誉，我说的每件事，只是在预防万一。」
抹去泪，他的声音还是很镇定。「我知道。」
「我的舞蹈老师说，只要把准备做到一百分，成功的机率就会大幅提升，为了我的成功，阿誉是不是该容许我为自己做好准备？」
对、对、对，她说得都对，只不过，他怎会是她的准备范围？
商天雨无视他的叹息，摸索着，拉起他的手，折出一个和自己相同的动作，小指勾小指，拇指压拇指，她强迫他承诺。
content_en:
They talked about the future that they didn't know if they could realize, and planned for tomorrow and next year. As they talked, Shang Tianyu couldn't help crying, because she felt comforted, and because if this was the last journey, she was happy to have someone by her side.
"I'm going to bring a bunch of red roses to my sister," she said.
Jiang Yu remembered that Qingtian loved the red roses he sent her most. He had said that he would build her a castle full of roses, but it was a pity that it was too late to fulfill his promise. "Okay, a big, big handful."
"I want to tell my sister that Ayu is a very good man."
"Thank you for the compliment. I want to tell her that I will take good care of her Tiao Tiao, even better than she does."
She lowered her head as if she were confessing and said, "My sister is always very nice to me, but I treat her very badly."
"How did you treat her so badly?"
"When I was little, she would let me do whatever I wanted. Even when I went on a date with my boyfriend, she would take me with her."
Speaking of this, he had to agree with her. "Yes, I have never been such a coward when it comes to having a girlfriend. I was in love while being a nanny. At that time, I really hated you, my teeth itched with hatred."
She nodded, and then said in a sad voice: "Now I want to steal my sister's boyfriend. Maybe it will be my sister's turn to hate me so much that her teeth itch."
"Rob? Do you think too highly of yourself?"
He pushed her stupid head, this guy's head was full of guilt.
"What do you mean?"
"Who do you think I am, a man you can snatch away if you want? No, if I don't like him, it won't matter how rich or beautiful you are! The point is, I'm not your boyfriend, I'm your responsibility." His forehead touched hers.
"Responsibility?"
"You have to bear my burden for the rest of my life. I am older than you and will get Alzheimer's disease earlier than you. When the time comes, you have to push a wheelchair and take me around. You have to help me wear a silver chain on my hand and write my name, address and phone number. If I lose it, you have to find me back as soon as possible."
She frowned. "Sounds scary."
"People say people with bad tempers are prone to high blood pressure. I have a stinky face and a bad temper. If I have a stroke, you have to take me to rehabilitation every day and help me bathe and change diapers."
She hits him. "Don't scare me."
He can hit her as he pleases, but the beating is all about love, and the more he beats, the stronger the love will be, so she will be reluctant to leave him. "I work so hard, I might have liver disease a long time ago. Liver disease is very troublesome. Have you ever read "The Food Code"? When the time comes, you have to cook me one meal at a time according to what is written in the book."
"Stop, stop! Don't continue this topic." She pricked her ears and didn't want to hear it.
"Afraid?"
"Afraid." She nodded.
"Then are you still willing to love me? Do you mind being with me?"
"I want to be with Ayu." There is no need to think about this kind of thing! Even if he suffers from Alzheimer's disease, high blood pressure, diabetes, schizophrenia, or AIDS, she will always be with him.
Only then was he satisfied. "So you didn't steal anyone. You were responsible for Qingtian. If she can't do it, you have to help her."
"Is that so?" she wondered.
"That's right." He confirmed.
"From now on, my sister will be the eldest wife and I will be the little wife." She was used to Kong Rong giving the pear to him and loving each other brother and sister.
"You can take the red roses to the grave and discuss it with Qingtian. I don't have any objection to who is older and who is younger. You sisters can go to Qiao by yourself, but... I heard that men prefer their younger wives. Do you think Qingtian really likes to be the boss?"
He used an alternative solution to deal with her guilt.
Shang Tianyu also felt stupid. It’s unknown whether he will be able to walk out of the surgery room tomorrow, but he’s actually discussing the order?
"Uncle Shang will return to Taiwan tomorrow. If he can make it in time, he will send you to the operating room." He finally decided to inform Uncle Shang that the risk of the operation was too high. Whether it was Uncle Shang or Tiao Tiao, he did not want either of them to regret it.
"My dad? Why did you tell him?"
"Don't be angry with him. None of the children in the world know what it means to be a parent.What a hard job. "
She pouted. "It sounds like you like him very much?"
"I like him." Jiang Yu admitted. Uncle Shang is not a bad person, he is just a man who doesn't know how to deal with the loss of a loved one.
"Would you like to go on a date? If my dad doesn't reject bisexuality, I wouldn't mind you being my stepmother."
She winked at him.
He kissed her and continued playing. "Don't worry, I won't abuse my stepdaughter."
Shang Tianyu burst into laughter. "Actually, I'm not angry with him."
"I know." If she was angry, how could she mind those boring curses that delayed her condition.
"Is he... okay?"
"Not bad, but he misses you."
"Ayu...if he can't make it in time, can you send a message for me and tell him that I'm not angry with him."
"He can't make it in time. Wait until you finish the operation and tell him in person." He said these words with a guilty conscience. The test report drained his confidence. In the past few days, he struggled repeatedly, considering whether to give up the operation. He was very scared, fearing that he would be the executioner and ruin the last few months of her life.
She was not a person who liked extravagant expectations, so she immediately changed the subject. "What if I wake up and forget who you are?"
"Be Mr. Writer again and make you fall in love with me again."
"What would you do if I decided to become a fairy in the end?"
Jiang Yu suddenly hugged her tightly, and then pretended to be relaxed and said, "Qingtian and I have conspired, Shang's mother belongs to her, and Tiaotiao belongs to me, so I'm sorry, there is no Shang Tianyu in the fairy list."
"I will try my best to survive this surgery, but what if-"
"Nothing bad," he cut her off.
She patted his big hand and said, "Let me tell you, I want everything to be arranged."
Like she arranged his and Du Juan's happiness? Foolishly, no one or anything in the world can be arranged. If you don't reach the last step, no one can know where you are destined.
He thought so, but didn't say it. What he said was - "What do you want to arrange?"
"Don't cry for me, I want you to happily send me to my mother and sister."
He shook his head without thinking. It was impossible for him not to cry or be happy. She was forcing things on others. He hugged her tightly and buried his head in her neck.
"I am a member of the Appearance Association. If I unfortunately become a vegetative state after the operation, can I... give up first aid when I get infected for the first time?" She pulled his sleeve and asked painfully.
He didn't answer.
"When I'm buried, Ayu, can you help me put on the blue bird's dance clothes? Whether I'm with you or not, I will try my best to be Ayu's little bluebird and bring happiness to Ayu."
He continued to remain silent.
She thought to herself and said: "When I become a real blue bird, I will search in the world to find a good girl for Ayu, let her love you, cherish you, and take care of you in the next few decades."
"I don't need anyone to take care of me."
"Yes, Ayu works too hard and needs a woman to take care of his body; Ayu's heart is very empty and needs someone to listen to his voice. If I find such a good woman, I will let her appear in front of Ayu wearing a little blue dress. If Ayu is moved, I will work hard to pursue her, okay?"
She stretched out her thumb and little finger, wanting to make a promise with him, but Jiang Yu was stubborn and refused, so he wrapped his big palm in her little hand.
"Ayu, I'm very worried about you..."
"What you should worry about is how to win tomorrow's war."
"Of course I will try my best to win, but I just want to feel more at ease and move forward without worries."
She opened the big hand that wrapped around her and childishly pushed out her thumb and little finger.
Jiang Yu stared at her steadily, a sour breath filling his nose. The success rate of the operation is so low, and her gambling luck is extremely bad. Is it really the last thing she can do to explain her funeral?
He didn't want to let go, and he didn't want to let the god of death stand in front of him and mock his love. Two tears fell down, and he didn't allow himself to choke.Swallow, look away, still holding her in his arms.
"Ayu, everything I said is just a precaution."
Wiping away tears, his voice remained calm. "I know."
"My dance teacher said that as long as you prepare 100%, your chance of success will be greatly increased. For my success, should Ayu allow me to prepare myself?"
Yes, yes, yes, she was right, but how could he be within her scope of preparation?
Shang Tianyu ignored his sigh, fumbled, took his hand, and made the same movement as hers, hooking her little finger with her little finger and pressing her thumb with her thumb. She forced him to commit.
